classification.difficultyReason: Identify the two whisker endpoints as the extreme prices and read their values, interpolating the minimum between scale ticks.

content.prompt: The boxplot below shows the price (in $\$$) of 20 different brands of sports shirts.

spec.description: Horizontal boxplot with scale above, labels 10 through 50 at intervals of 10, minor ticks every 2, and uncapped whisker endpoints. Decorative blue source strokes become black.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied plot is permanently visible; numerical endpoint answers appear only in answer editions.

children.prompt: What is the cost of the most expensive and least expensive sports shirt?

answer.worked: The right whisker endpoint gives the maximum price, $\$48$. The left whisker endpoint gives the minimum price, $\$11$.
